# Suffering and comfort: passages

**Status: approved by the owner on 2026-11-12** (the owner approved every theme’s passages in advance; this record lists them so any can still be changed).

Pain, loss and persecution, and God's comfort in them.

Chosen by `pnpm themes:build`: OpenBible’s vote score (0–10 within its topic) plus 4 per Nave row citing the passage; the best 12 per sub-theme, at most one per section and 3 per book. References are WEBC (English) numbering; titles are the sections’ own.
